mapper.insert: insert into score ( score_no, student_no, score_type, score_name, score_subject, score_score, score_rank, score_date ) values ( score_seq.nextval, #{studentNo}, #{scoreType}, #{scoreName}, #{scoreSubject}, #{scoreScore}, #{scoreRank}, #{scoreDate} )
mapper.select: select score_no as scoreNo, student_no as studentNo, score_type as scoreType, score_name as scoreName, score_subject as scoreSubject, score_score as scoreScore, score_rank as scoreRank, score_date as scoreDate, score_wtime as scoreWtime from score where score_no = #{scoreNo}

select score_no as scoreNo, student_no as studentNo, score_type as scoreType, score_name as scoreName, score_subject as scoreSubject, score_score as scoreScore, score_rank as scoreRank, score_date as scoreDate, score_wtime as scoreWtime from score where student_no = #{studentNo} order by score_date desc
mapper.update: update score set score_type = #{scoreType}, score_name = #{scoreName}, score_subject = #{scoreSubject}, score_score = #{scoreScore}, score_rank = #{scoreRank}, score_date = #{scoreDate} where score_no = #{scoreNo}
